/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if test -f /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/375deb7ed43f/workspace/round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,240p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/375deb7ed43f/workspace/round-brief.md; else echo 'NO ROUND BRIEF'; fi
printf '\\n--- DOD ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md

git status --short && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | sed -n '1,160p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current
printf '\\n--- validation ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
printf '\\n--- validation tests ---\\n'; sed -n '1,300p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts
printf '\\n--- git recent ---\\n'; git log --oneline -8
printf '\\n--- specs status/links snippets ---\\n'; rg -n \"replays an entry whose turn is still running|with latest on|with resume absent|with resume off|with resume on\" specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | sed -n '1,260p'

git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "Harden websocket frame validation" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse @{upstream}'
